name: How long does the project coordination phase typically last for a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does the project coordination phase typically last for a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the project coordination phase is directly tied to the scope and complexity of the home remodel itself. For a minor renovation, coordination might last a few weeks. For a larger whole-home remodel or significant addition, it could extend for several months, or even over a year. The coordinator's involvement begins during planning and continues through all construction phases until project completion and final walkthroughs. Effective coordination aims to optimize the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project coordination duration depends on remodel scope; it can range from weeks for minor jobs to over a year for extensive renovations.
